regime_context: The detector shows a deeply one-narrative market: Oil & Gas Producers (XEG.TO) is the sole trend-eligible, high-durability, high-breadth leader, while every Precious Metals theme is trend-ineligible despite decent rank — a rotation-glass view of discipline, not return prediction. Track record (dir_accuracy 0.324 on n=111) says directional precision is poor, so the only defensible levers are staying-power and shake-out control, expressed as narrow conditionals.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (XGD.TO) sits rank 2 but remains trend-ineligible — I am watching for XGD.TO to clear its own absolute-trend gate (become eligible=true) while XEG.TO breadth falls below 0.8, which would signal a CONFIRMED leadership handoff away from oil and retire this watch.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: XEG.TO is the only theme combining trend-gate eligibility, the highest durability_bar (0.71), exceptional breadth (0.929), and confirmed one-narrative leadership. The absolute-trend gate is the single validated edge (drawdown/shake-out avoidance), so a lean here is a stay-with-leadership view, not a momentum alpha view. Crowding (crowding_z 1.19, crowded=true) is a size-down caution, never a reason to leave.
evidence: eligible=true (only leading theme passing the absolute-trend gate)
durability_bar=0.71 — the only leader with sustained trend health
breadth=0.929 — leadership is cohesive across constituents, not a single-name spike
rotation.one_narrative=true with margin 0.895 over challenger Gold Miners
backtest_verdict: absolute_trend_gate validated as risk control
theses.dissent: Rank-IC is ~0 so the score conveys no return edge; if this is late-stage reflexivity (one_narrative + crowded + high r10), the absolute gate still has no forward return power and XEG could simply chop while energy commodities roll over and breadth quietly decays.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO loses trend-gate eligibility (its own absolute trend breaks) or its breadth drops below 0.7 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks (ZEB.TO) is the only other trend-eligible theme with a genuine trend tag (hurst_tag='trend'), a respectable durability_bar (0.63), and no crowding flag. Under a one-narrative regime, this is a defensive second-leg: if the oil leadership wobbles and rotation narrows further, banks are the only other theme still passing the absolute-trend gate, giving it shake-out value.
evidence: hurst_tag='trend' — cleanest trend character outside Energy
theses.dissent: Breadth is only 0.429, so a large part of the theme is lagging; if the rotation truly narrows to a single oil narrative (absorption 0.31 and dropping), banks provide no diversification benefit and simply lag while oil carries the index.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO loses trend-gate eligibility or its breadth falls below 0.3 before the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology (XIT.TO) is trend-eligible but carries the most extreme crowding flag in the ranks (crowding_z 1.36, crowded=true) with a mixed hurst tag and a near-zero score. Under the guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — but with no momentum edge and mixed trend health, there is no reason to lean into it; avoidance is the natural posture when a theme offers neither durability nor a clean trend signal.
evidence: crowding_z=1.36 — highest crowding in the universe
theses.dissent: Technology often carries the broadest macro-narrative attention (macro_narrative shows ai_tech as a top theme) and could easily re-assert itself as rotation broadens; avoiding it forfeits participation if the one-narrative oil regime breaks and flows rotate back to tech.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO clears trend eligibility with a clean 'trend' hurst tag AND its crowding_z falls below 0.5 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
